他们的爱情故事很感人。: 她很有爱心，常常帮助小动物。
She is very caring and often helps small animals.

love (romantic love): to go through a security check
To take a plane, you must go through security first.
column6: 安检 is short for 安全检查. People say 过安检 for "go through security".

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 我已经安排好了明天的工作。
I have already arranged tomorrow's work.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 你进电梯以后，请按八楼。
After you get into the lift, please press eight.
column6: 按 also goes before a noun and means "according to": 按我说的做.

You should take your medicine on time.
Please do it according to the teacher's requirements.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 爷爷喜欢喝一点儿白酒。
Grandpa likes to drink a little baijiu.
column6: 白酒 is a strong clear Chinese spirit. It is not the same as white wine.

love (romantic love): to work in an office; to do office work
I am working from home today.
You need a passport to apply for a visa.

love (romantic love): to handle matters; to run an errand
他们的爱情故事很感人。: 他出去办事了，下午才回来。
He has gone out to take care of something and will only be back in the afternoon.
Your Chinese is really great!
column6: 棒 is a warm, casual word of praise: 真棒！ 太棒了！

We must protect the environment.
I promise not to be late in the future.
column6: 保证 can also be a noun: 一个保证 (a guarantee).

love (romantic love): to hold in one's arms; to hug
Mom is holding the child in her arms.

love (romantic love): to apply to take an entrance exam
他们的爱情故事很感人。: 他想报考这个城市的大学。
He wants to apply to a university in this city.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 我报名参加了汉语比赛。
I signed up for the Chinese competition.
Sorry, I am late.
He is carrying a big bag on his back.
column6: 背 is read bēi here. It is read bèi in 背课文 (recite a text from memory).

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 我的背包里有一本书和一件衣服。
My backpack has a book and a piece of clothing.

love (romantic love): northern part; the north of a place
Winters in the north of China are very cold.
His salary is twice mine.
He is studying for his bachelor's degree in Beijing.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 我本来想去，可是太累了。
I originally wanted to go, but I was too tired.
I am so stupid, I cannot even do this.
column6: 笨 sounds harsh about another person. It is usually used of oneself or as a joke.

He has a high nose.

love (romantic love): to take a written exam; a written exam
After the written exam there is also an interview.
I graduate next year.
There are many graduates this year.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 为了便于联系，请留下你的电话。
To make it easy to contact you, please leave your phone number.
His Mandarin is very standard.
column6: 标准 is a noun (a standard) and an adjective (standard, correct).

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 我的表坏了，所以不知道现在几点。
My watch has broken, so I do not know the time now.
column6: 表 means a watch (手表) and a table or chart (时间表). It is also in words like 表示.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 这个表格里有你的名字吗？
Is your name in this form?

love (romantic love): to express; to show; to mean
He nodded to show agreement.
His performance today is very good.
column6: 表现 is a verb (to show) and a noun (performance, behaviour).

The teacher praised me.
I like chocolate biscuits.

love (romantic love): (emphasises a negative) not at all; in fact
This is not hard at all.
column6: 并 before 不 or 没 makes the "no" stronger: 并不 (not at all), 并没有 (did not at all).

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 他会说汉语，并且说得很好。
He can speak Chinese, and speaks it very well.

love (romantic love): to broadcast; to play (audio or video)
The news is being broadcast on TV.
She is doing a PhD in the United States.
column6: 博士 is a doctoral degree or the person who holds it. A medical doctor is 医生.

You do not need to come; I will go myself.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 他的腿受伤了，走路不便。
His leg is hurt, so walking is inconvenient for him.
The weather keeps getting colder.
I do not have enough money.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 这个菜很好吃，不过有点儿辣。
This dish is tasty, but a little spicy.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 不论天气怎么样，我们都去。
No matter what the weather is like, we are going.
column6: 不论 means the same as 不管. The second half usually has 都 or 也.

He took two steps forward.

love (romantic love): measure word for films, series and phones; part
This film is really good.
column6: 部 is the measure word for films, TV series and phones: 一部电影, 一部手机. It also means "part" or "ministry" in words like 部分 and 部门.

love (romantic love): have no choice but to; must
他们的爱情故事很感人。: 下雨了，我们不得不回家。
It rained, so we had no choice but to go home.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 这本书的前一部分很有意思。
The first part of this book is very interesting.
No matter how late, I will wait for you.
column6: 不管 is like 不论: the second half usually has 都 or 也.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 他不光会唱歌，还会跳舞。
He can not only sing, but also dance.

他们的爱情故事很感人。: 她不仅聪明，而且很努力。
She is not only smart, but also very hardworking.
The customers are very unhappy with the price.
Which department are you from?

love (romantic love): not as good as; might as well
My Chinese is not as good as his.
